measurement_technique: Synthesis of published molecular divergence-time estimates into a single timetree; pairwise query returns the median/precomputed age and confidence interval.
role: divergence times between Darwin's replacing species pairs (Rhea pennata/R. americana, the two endemic New Zealand bats, Falkland wolf vs Arctic fox) and between the ratites he contrasts

notes: The pair Mimus melanotis / Mimus trifasciatus was rejected by the API ('are the same. Please choose taxa from different groups'), so no divergence time is recorded for the Galapagos mockingbirds.
